compiled_state.title: [reconciler:outbound-update]: local field edits do not propagate to Jira -> Jira retains original values; matrix shows FAIL for all updatable fields
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

**Component:** plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py / outbound_differ.py routing
**Condition:** Local edits to bound tickets followed by reconciler pass
**Observed Result:** Jira issues retain original values; no fields propagate from local to Jira on outbound update path

**code_version:** 852cd0bf38f99b4b2392526abd22b4d260148547

## Reproduction

Run `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/e2e_field_validation_probe.sh` (requires JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN and DSO_FIELD_VALIDATION_PROBE=1). Phase 2 makes local edits then runs the reconciler:
- Ticket 1: edit title local -> Jira summary unchanged
- Ticket 1: edit description local -> Jira description unchanged
- Ticket 2: edit priority 0->3 -> Jira priority stays Highest
- Ticket 5: unassign local -> Jira assignee stays
- Ticket 6: add label-d / remove label-a -> Jira labels: only dso-id:* (no user labels)
- Ticket 8: add second comment -> Jira comments: not present

Phase 1 outbound CREATE works for single-field attributes (title/priority/issuetype/assignee), so the OutboundMutation pipeline works for creates. The UPDATE path is broken.

## Expected Behavior

After a local edit and reconciler pass, the corresponding Jira issue reflects the new field value(s).

## Actual Behavior

After the reconciler pass, Jira issues retain their original CREATE-time values. No error is raised; the reconciler reports OK. Listed in the field validation matrix from probe run field-probe-1779942291 (committed on branch fix/d822-head-drift):
- Outbound update: title FAIL, description FAIL, priority FAIL, assignee FAIL, labels FAIL, comments FAIL
- Outbound create (for comparison): title PASS, priority PASS, issuetype PASS, assignee PASS

## Suspected Root Causes

H1: Outbound update mutations from the new outbound differ go through the LEGACY `_apply_batch` path (lines 2270+) rather than the typed `_apply_outbound_update` leaf (lines 192+). The legacy batch path reads `mutation.get('action')` and `mutation.get('fields')` — but the typed-Mutation-converted dict (reconcile.py lines 524-568 'update' branch) puts changed fields under `changed_fields` key, not `fields`. So `update_one` may receive no fields.

H2: `_mutation_to_batch_dict` (if it exists in applier.py) normalises typed Mutations to dicts — and its mapping for action=update may use the wrong payload key.

H3: `update_one` ignores the fields dict and only handles status/priority routing.

H4: Labels and comments arrays in the payload don't go through update_issue — they need separate add_label / add_comment / remove_label / add_comment calls that aren't being made by either the legacy batch path or the typed leaf.

## Key Code Paths

- outbound_differ.py:205-275 compute_outbound_mutations -> emits OutboundMutation with action='update', fields={...changed Jira-side names...}, comments[], labels[]
- reconcile.py:524-568 converts OutboundMutation -> typed Mutation; for action='update' sets target=jira_key, payload={'changed_fields': om.fields, 'comments': om.comments, 'labels': om.labels}
- applier.py:192-248 _apply_outbound_update reads payload['changed_fields'], filters allowlist, calls client.update_issue
- applier.py apply() partitions mutations into inbound_typed (dispatched via _apply_typed) and outbound_or_untyped (dispatched via _apply_batch legacy). Question: do outbound typed Mutations stay typed all the way to _apply_outbound_update, or do they get normalised to dicts and routed through legacy batch?

## Cascade Concern

Inbound UPDATE failures (Phase 3) likely cascade from this bug: when local==edited and Jira==unsynced, the differ's local-wins resolution treats every field as conflicted and drops the inbound update. Resolving outbound update propagation should restore inbound update behavior automatically.

## Affected Validation Matrix Cells (probe field-probe-1779942291)

| Field       | Outbound Create | Outbound Update | Inbound Update |
| title       | PASS            | FAIL            | FAIL           |
| description | FAIL            | FAIL            | FAIL           |
| priority    | PASS            | FAIL            | FAIL           |
| assignee    | PASS            | FAIL            | FAIL           |
| labels      | FAIL            | FAIL            | FAIL           |
| comments    | FAIL            | FAIL            | NOT_SUPPORTED  |
